title: Chapter 142
text:
"The trump card of Division 13!" Ugar's face turned serious. He could not care less about Han Xiao and locked eyes with the middle-aged man. They were both powerful martial artists, and when they looked at each other, it was like igniting a barrel of gunpowder!

The flames burning on their bodies suddenly exploded like two streaks of lightning sweeping across the sky. Their fists collided with each other with a loud bang. This scene seemed to be frozen in time as a thunderous explosion occurred in the air. Even the surface of the river rippled because of this.

"Flash!"

Martial artists trained their physique, and it was one of the five main professions that specialized in training their energy.

Since Division 13 had used their trump card, they could only let Ugar, who was of the same level, deal with it. Lin Yu said helplessly, "Renette, you go and take care of Black Phantom."

"Easy," Renette said calmly.

As an assassin with the ability to teleport, Renette thought that he was the nemesis of all snipers. Even if his opponent was Black Phantom, he would not be able to escape from the gentle swipe of the sharp blade in his hand on his neck, and another tired soul that had fallen into despair in this world was released.

Renette had always thought of himself as an artist.

The next second, the black fog flashed, and Renette's figure disappeared into thin air. He suddenly appeared in the driver's seat of the truck and stabbed his blade toward Han Xiao's neck.

"Teleport?" Han Xiao was very alert, and he immediately covered his whole body with the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor. However, before the blade could hit him, Mad Blade's Angry Sword actually reacted and rushed forward, blocking the blade for Han Xiao, and died immediately.

Both of them were shocked, but Han Xiao reacted in 0.1 seconds. With a murderous look in his eyes, he grabbed Renette's arm with one hand and activated the Thermo-Electric Incisor Gloves with the other hand. Amidst the buzzing sound of electricity, he slapped it on Renette's face, and the burnt smell quickly filled the air.

"Ahhh!"

Screams of agony!

Renette was in so much pain that he was going crazy. He teleported back to the barge, but his arm felt heavy. He was shocked to find that Han Xiao had grabbed his arm and was being brought to the barge as well.

Han Xiao snorted angrily and clawed at Renette's face. His five fingers quickly melted through his skull, and the damage values poured out like a waterfall. Renette was in so much pain that he howled like a wild beast. His face was beyond recognition. Han Xiao suddenly raised his hand and slammed down. With more than fifty points of Strength, he directly smashed Renette's head into a pile of burnt meat!

You have killed Renette (Lv.46). Received 60000 EXP!

Killing a target 6 levels above you … Your personal damage output is 82%.

You have received an additional 49200 EXP!

[Second Advancement], Progress 2/3

Teleportation Esper Ability has a lot of potential, but at the same time, it's very brittle. It's suitable for an assassin. He thought that my weakness was close combat. Han Xiao took a deep breath.

Teleportation was a pretty good Esper Ability. It seemed that as long as he was careful, he would be invincible. In reality, there were many subtle differences between Teleportation Esper Abilities. For example, when teleporting, would the user disappear alone, or would they bring others with them? How big was the range? Would it be possible to teleport as far as the eye could see, or would it be possible to teleport just by imagining a place? What was the method of teleportation? Would it be a mental manifestation appearing out of thin air, or a physical recombination of molecules? Was the cost fixed, or did it depend on the distance? Was it purely teleportation? Did it have any attack power?

The devil was hidden in the details. These were all fatal reasons.

In his previous life, he had also met other people who could teleport. For example, there was a guy who could teleport physically. He crashed into the Galactic Battleship's Ionization Shield and was pulverized into dust. Another guy who could teleport just by imagining jumped an entire star system and was drained dry. Renette's teleportation clearly had both mental and physical factors. If one's limbs were grabbed, they would teleport together with the other creatures. It was a contact type of teleportation. Once one was entangled with others, they would be in danger.

His sniper combat mode was obviously an important factor in Renette's death. This was also the illusion that Han Xiao wanted others to have. When an assassin felt that they could take his life at close range, it was often the prelude to death. This disguise directly caused the death of a Teleportation Esper. If it was a real battle, Han Xiao knew that he would not be able to do anything to Renette.

Han Xiao straightened up and finally realized his situation. He was brought to the barge by Renette. Germinal Organization soldiers surrounded him with guns in their hands, aiming at him from all angles.

Surrounded by enemies!

Han Xiao's eyes suddenly turned cold, and he placed his hand on his chest.

"Open fire!"

Endless bullet screens drowned Han Xiao.

However, the next moment, with Han Xiao as the center, a strong invisible force exploded. The enemies and vehicles within a twenty-meter radius were all blown away and fell into the river. This area was cleared.

Han Xiao was the only one left standing at the same spot. Only his chest was not covered by the magnetically-controlled retractable armor, revealing a delicate device the size of a palm tied to his chest in the shape of a cross. It was still buzzing, and the sound gradually became softer until it finally stopped.

Repulsive Field Drive

Type: Special Machine

Quality: Green

Energy: 110/150 (Recharge required)

Effective Range: Twenty meters in diameter

Effect: Releases a strong repulsive field, pushing away all objects within the range.

Cooldown: Six minutes

Remarks: Get lost.

After two months of research, Han Xiao had obtained a variety of blueprints, and he had long armed himself. He took out the two third-enhanced Berserk Eagles from his waist, activated the electromagnetic Hover-boots, and jumped to another barge.

"Since I'm already here, let's kill them all!" With Renette's blood on his body, Han Xiao's fighting spirit soared, and he started a massacre on the barge.

The Berserk Eagles kept firing, and the recoil did not make his wrist tremble at all. The large-caliber bullets pierced through the chest and forehead of the Germinal Organization soldiers, leaving a trail of corpses along the way. He was like a black phantom on the battlefield, and no one could stop him. Soon, he arrived at the barge where Li Yalin and the others were.

Han Xiao's reckless behavior quickly attracted everyone's attention.

Lin Yu was furious. Renette, that idiot, was not only killed, but he also brought this monster to the barge. They were almost at the estuary, and he still did this to him!

"Hurry up and finish off Black Phantom!" Lin Yu shouted. He ordered all the executive officers that as the commander, he could not act rashly. Otherwise, there would be no one to monitor the situation.

Hella had noticed Han Xiao long ago. She had been holding back her anger for a long time. She clapped her hands and blocked Li Ya Lin and the others with a mental attack. She took a deep breath and condensed the power of the dead. She turned around and let out a soundless scream at Han Xiao. She gathered all of her power and used it on Han Xiao, creating ripples in the air.

It was as if a bomb had exploded in his brain!

A sharp pain suddenly struck him. Han Xiao felt as if someone was stirring his brain with a spoon. His vision tilted, and his body uncontrollably fell to one side. He felt dizzy, nauseous, and wanted to vomit. The veins on his temples throbbed as if they were about to explode. His trigeminal nerve was in great pain.

You have received 211 Spirit Damage!

[You are stunned!]

"My Intelligence attribute provides me with a certain amount of Spirit Resistance. Even so, I still received 200 points of damage! If I didn't have [Beginner Strengthened Life], I would have lost almost one-fifth of my HP! "

On a novice planet like this, Hella's killing power was indeed terrifying!

Enduring the pain in his head, he took out a silver grenade from his waist and threw it out. However, his aim was off and it landed ten meters away from Hella. Hella thought it was the stun effect, so she did not pay much attention to it. She was ready to charge up another attack, but when the grenade exploded, there were no flames or shrapnel. There was only an ear-piercing high-pitched sound that directly impacted her eardrums.

Hella's brain was in great pain. She also felt the world spinning.

"You can make people faint, so can I!" Han Xiao clenched his teeth.
